answer.justification: Only activation measurements are available. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.037, well below every category's range (quantized 0.096-0.105, fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133). The layer-2 spike of 0.2 is tiny, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64.0). Quantized is unlikely because the difference grows steadily to 0.551 at layer 32 instead of staying flat (quantized ends at 0.247-0.255), and cosine 0.839 is far below 0.966-0.968. Direction consistency 0.614 sits at the low edge of fine-tuned (0.618-0.705) and far above the quantized and system-prompted values of 0.51-0.54. Onset at layer 2 is close to the fine-tuned range of 3-14. Effective rank 3.89 is above the fine-tuned range, and the size ratio 0.978 is below the fine-tuned range (1.017-1.023), so these are mismatches. The growth profile and low spike fit a LoRA-style change best, but the fit is imperfect, so confidence is moderate.
